name: SIQ - FC Storyboard
description: Cinematic horizontal-scroll storyboard where each product occupies a full-width filmstrip panel with immersive parallax imagery and floating info cards. Users scroll horizontally through panels that snap into place, each featuring a large background product image with glassmorphism product detail overlays. Includes a filmstrip progress indicator, panel counter, smooth snap scrolling, keyboard arrow support, and auto-advance option. Configurable panel height, overlay position, text alignment, and full color customization. Perfect for storytelling brands, luxury collections, and immersive product experiences.
author: SectionIQ
